title: tanacetum tatsienense var. tanacetopsis
intro: Tanacetum tatsienense var. tanacetopsis, commonly known as Tatsienense Tanacetopsis or Chinese Tansy, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote digestion, relieve menstrual cramps, and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Tanacetum tatsienense var. tanacetopsis include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, alleviate menstrual pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
